items.description: Locate leak and open bathroom wall
items.rationale: The internal pipe fracture is insured under §1.1, and §2.1 covers both locating the leak and opening the wall. Two hours at €95 gross per hour gives €190.

items.description: Replace split 15 mm copper pipe section
items.rationale: Section 2.2 covers replacement of the fractured section. Allow €185 gross for fitting the short copper section, including fittings and excluding the wall access billed separately.

items.description: Close, re-plaster and re-tile wall patch
items.rationale: Sections 2.1 and 2.3 cover closing the opening and restoring the plaster and tiles to their prior standard. Allow €240 gross for the 0.2 m² patch, including small-job labour and materials but no work to the rest of the bathroom.
Section 3.1 expressly excludes servicing and descaling even during the same visit, so the payable threshold is zero. The €200 estimate is conditional only.
